thread:
maria.g: Quick note  vendor sync TOMORROW 09:00 PT. Objective: nail down GA-ish windows for H100/H200/B200, MI300 regional shipping lanes, Gaudi revB stability, and the exact announce sequencing + marketplace gating.

oliver: Add press sequencing + embargo days to the agenda. We need fixed numbers to plan partner briefings.

sophie: Also confirm whether firmware/microcode counts as a separate embargo item — past partners treated it differently.

partner_bot: Calendar invite sent. Pre-read: compatibility snapshot + canary runbook. Please complete vendor preflight form.

devon: Infra conservative notes: H100 Dedicated pool target ~2025-06-14; H200 late July; MI300 NA shipments late June, eu-west may be +10d; B200/Gaudi TBD pending revB patch.

ravi-plg: Hosted API onramp preference: gated soft launch per wave to validate batching/KV-cache perf. Request: vendors provide early firmware/test images and, if possible, quantized export scripts (int8/4bit).

si-liaison: SI recommends onboarding order: (1) H100/H200, (2) MI300 (quantized flows), (3) Gaudi/B200 for cost lanes. Driver maturity dictates this.

press_ops: Past pattern: NVIDIA typically requested ~10d embargo after driver sign-off, AMD ~7d. We'll ask vendors to confirm exact days. If embargo >=14d we loop legal early.

legal: Confirming: anything labeled "microcode" or signed firmware may trigger IP review and separate embargo treatment. Capture it on the form.

maria.g: Proposed cadence: Wave Alpha = H100 (invite-only + Dedicated canaries); Wave Beta = MI300 + H200 (wider hosted + Dedicated); Wave Gamma = Gaudi + B200 (economy lane). Space waves ~2-3 weeks but adjust for embargoes/supply.

devon: Add fallback rule: if a vendor misses a wave cutoff, we auto-route to a compatible family (e.g., H100 -> H200-family) and mark UI with "compatibility_family" tag. Also enable regional fallback if supply limited.

ravi-plg: Routing + cost controls must be defined before Wave Beta. Internal sims show MI300 quantized paths can alter token cost materially (~25-35%). Need clear opt-in flags for customers.

si-liaison: SI needs canary AMIs/images per cloud, driver bundles, integration checklist, and a documented smoke-test harness. We'll provide a template.

anjali: Marketplace request: stable SKU taxonomy + region availability flags. Sample SKU format we want: `redwood:sku:v2|vendor:AMD|model:MI300|region:eu-west-1|wave:beta`. Also include `compatibility_family` and `embargo_days` metadata.

sophie: Runbook item: "late-driver-breaks" — hold announcement, kick vendor triage, enable fallback region, notify customers. Owner: partner-ops / press.

press_ops: If any vendor enforces a staggered embargo (e.g., microcode embargo separate from driver), we'll need to schedule preview blog post + partner joint blog on announce day. Capture preferred blackout windows.

maria.g: Action items before sync: 1) vendors complete preflight (ETA sign-off, embargo_days, microcode_embargo_boolean, region_limits), 2) infra publish canary plan + telemetry budget, 3) marketplace draft SKU taxonomy, 4) SI upload checklist.

partner_bot: Form: https://forms.redwood.example/onramp-2025-hw (auto-reminder in 12h).

oliver: One more ops ask: retain canary telemetry 30d (baseline) for initial waves; infra to attach storage cost estimate.

devon: Infra will carve temporary buckets for canaries and add cost to the tracker. Recommend a 150-instance golden canary for KV-cache/batching regression detection.

ravi-plg: For the sync, ask vendors specifically for quant artifacts or export scripts. That reduces SI time dramatically. Also ask for any cross-cloud image differences.

si-liaison: Heads-up from partner eng: Habana revB shows a kernel race under long-seq streaming; patch ETA mid-May. If patch slips >72h, move Gaudi to Wave Gamma only.

maria.g: We'll make wave assignments conditional on vendor sign-off. Who will present compatibility snapshot?

ravi-plg: I'll present and upload a short PDF by EOD.

maria.g: If you can't make 09:00 PT DM me and we'll 1:1 the vendor. See you tomorrow. :calendar: :rocket:
